China has warned the European Union that it will take countermeasures if Brussels adopts "restrictive and discriminatory" measures against it, as the European Commission works on a new trade tool, dubbed a "kill switch," that could cut off access to the EU market.
So what is this tool, why is Europe considering such a drastic step?
